"Elena was thrilled with the orchard view in June — she lingered there each morning with a book. Worth recreating."

On the first reply,
a guest's enquiry is a doorway. Answer within the hour. In the cases you'd rate the threshold itself.
On the small ask,
A bottle of Bandol, a softer linen than the last — turn it into a moment of welcome. The small fee is a request to manage.
On the silence afterward,
Not every message warrants a reply. A read receipt and a flicker of restraint will speak for themselves.
